objectives: To provide essential knowledge on physical activity, health, and wellness.
To ensure students understand body systems, exercise principles, nutrition, mental health, and disease management.
To educate students on the benefits of yoga, the risks of substance abuse and basic first aid skills.

subtopics: Strategies to prevent / manage common hypokinetic diseases and disorders
Cardiovascular diseases (e.g., coronary artery disease, hypertension)

subtopics: Meaning, Aims and objectives of yoga

outcomes: Explain the different human body systems and describe various types of physical activities along with methods to measure and quantify these activities.
Explain how to maintain or improve health and wellness through psychological practices, dietary habits, and sports activities.

Discuss about common hypokinetic disorders and musculoskeletal disorders, and describe the importance of leading a healthy lifestyle through the practice of yoga and abstaining from addictive substances.
Explain the basics of first aid and describe common sports injuries.
